no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not refer this BLA to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) because, in the setting of the boxed warning and other advice in the product labeling, the safety profile is acceptable for the treatment of the indicated population and the application did not raise significant public health questions regarding the role of naxitamab for this indication. Outside expertise was not necessary as there were no controversial issues that could benefit from an ODAC discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761171 (DANYELZA/naxitamab-gqgk). The FDA's Multidiscipline Review states the Division did not refer the BLA to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the safety profile was acceptable under the boxed warning and labeling, the application raised no significant public health questions, and there were no controversial issues warranting outside expertise. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
